typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFolder as string (),
	BCCSuccessEmail as string (),
	CCSuccessEmail as string (),
	CopyToArchive as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	FileFullPath as string (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	Market as string (),
	MessageSource as string (),
	OutboundFileName as string (),
	OutboundFolderPath as string (),
	SuccessEmail as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		CLAIM_ID as string,
		CHARGE_AMOUNT as string,
		PAID_AMOUNT as string,
		PAID_DT as string,
		GRGR_CK as string,
		SOURCE_SYSTEM as string,
		CLAIM_TYPE as string,
		SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR as string,
		SUBSC_FIRST_NAME as string,
		SUBSC_LAST_NAME as string,
		MBR_RLTNSHP_CD as string,
		FROM_DATE as string,
		POLICY_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @grgr_ck VARCHAR(10) = ?  SELECT DISTINCT 	 MEMBER_ID 	,SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR  	,SUBSC_FIRST_NAME  	,SUBSC_LAST_NAME  	,MBR_RLTNSHP_CD  	,CLCL_ID AS CLAIM_ID 	,CHARGE_AMOUNT 	,PAID_AMOUNT 	,PAID_DT 	,GRGR_CK 	,SOURCE_SYSTEM 	,CLAIM_TYPE             	,CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT AS FROM_DATE 	,MECB_POLICY_ID AS POLICY_ID FROM [dbo].[A2AMonthlyClaimsImport] WHERE GRGR_CK = @grgr_ck ORDER BY MEMBER_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DMQDataMiningAnthemMedicaidClaims
DMQDataMiningAnthemMedicaidClaims derive(MARKET_NAME = $Market) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(DC_SUBSC_LAST_NAME = SUBSC_LAST_NAME,
		DC_PAID_AMOUNT = PAID_AMOUNT,
		DC_CHARGE_AMOUNT = CHARGE_AMOUNT,
		{Copy of POLICY_ID} = POLICY_ID,
		{Copy of FROM_DATE} = FROM_DATE,
		DC_SOURCE_SYSTEM = SOURCE_SYSTEM,
		DC_GRGR_CK = GRGR_CK,
		DC_MEMBER_ID = MEMBER_ID,
		DC_SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR = SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR,
		DC_SUBSC_FIRST_NAME = SUBSC_FIRST_NAME,
		DC_CLAIM_TYPE = CLAIM_TYPE,
		DC_MBR_RLTNSHP_CD = MBR_RLTNSHP_CD,
		DC_CLAIM_ID = CLAIM_ID,
		DC_PAID_DT = PAID_DT) ~> DCNVConvertUnicodetoPlainString
DCNVConvertUnicodetoPlainString sink(input(
		DC_PAID_DT as string,
		{Copy of FROM_DATE} as string,
		DC_CLAIM_ID as string,
		DC_CHARGE_AMOUNT as string,
		DC_PAID_AMOUNT as string,
		DC_GRGR_CK as string,
		DC_SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR as string,
		{Copy of POLICY_ID} as string,
		DC_SOURCE_SYSTEM as string,
		DC_SUBSC_FIRST_NAME as string,
		DC_MEMBER_ID as string,
		DC_CLAIM_TYPE as string,
		DC_SUBSC_LAST_NAME as string,
		MARKET_NAME as string,
		DC_MBR_RLTNSHP_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> EXDSTAnthemMedicaidA2AMonthClaims
